claim_ceiling: The V19 corrected-EXE root succeeded but no in-motion successor was admitted; diagnostic Fabric logs identify per-event projection latency and heartbeat queueing. Projection batching is built and deterministically tested, not yet live accepted.

fabric_delivery_log.in_motion_example: At local 18:00:57, projection was pending with 10 outbox entries, latest acknowledged sequence 3, and heartbeat age 9905 ms; the native root later settled before the projection stream drained.
fabric_delivery_log.interpretation: The projection endpoint and client delivery lane are serializing one HTTP POST per event. Observed delivery latency is sufficient to push the projected checkpoint behind the unchanged five-second current-evidence window. This is transport evidence, not proof of a single server substage.

candidate_patch.purpose: Coalesce a frozen ordered prefix of projection events into one server-supported event batch, preserve byte-identical retry and checkpoint fences, and validate receipt identity before acknowledgement.
